name: When should I get an ADU feasibility consultation?

mainEntity.name: When should I get an ADU feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get an ADU feasibility consultation early in your planning process, ideally before engaging architects or engineers for detailed designs. This ensures your project aligns with local regulations and avoids costly redesigns. It's particularly useful if you are unsure about the specific ADU rules in cities like Berkeley or Alameda, which may have unique requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a consultation early in your planning to understand regulations and avoid redesigns, especially in areas with unique ADU rules.
